import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String x = scanner.nextLine();
        StringBuilder y = new StringBuilder();
        y.append(x.charAt(0));
        boolean stop = false;
        int i = 1;
        while (i < x.length()) {
            if (i + 1 < x.length() && x.charAt(i) == 'a' && x.charAt(i + 1) == 't' && !stop) {
                y.append('@');
                i += 2;
                stop = true;
            } else if (i + 2 < x.length() && x.charAt(i) == 'd' && x.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && x.charAt(i + 2) == 't') {
                y.append('.');
                i += 3;
            } else {
                y.append(x.charAt(i));
                i++;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(y.toString());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
